acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks about the drama of trying to be "just friends" with an ex-girlfriend. The meaning of the title will be clear if you hear the piece.
acts.title: When You're In Love, The Whole World Is Jewish

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Fiction writer George Saunders reads his story "Offloading for Mrs Schwartz," from his book CivilWarLand in Bad Decline. It's the story of someone who can't get over the death of his ex-wife. .
acts.title: Wishing For Amnesia

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Who among us has not wanted amnesia to help get over someone or something? But the problem with amnesia is that it happens a lot more in TV shows and movies and novels than it does in real life. We send reporter Scott Carrier to find someone who really has had amnesia. It's such a difficult assignment that at some point, he visits a hypnotist and asks her to take his memory away.
acts.title: Finding Amnesia
